thread:
Sam: Quick sync  SecureEdge wants a joint AWS/GCP marketplace tile + co-demo. Required: SAML SSO (SP metadata), SCIM provisioning (they use externalId), and BYOK via KMIP or on-prem PKCS#11. Can we assign owners and a short timeline? @Priya @Diego

Priya: I'll own SSO + SCIM. Need SP metadata XML, SCIM base URL, and if they support incremental sync. Note: they surface groups as `groups.externalId`.

Diego: I'll take KMS/HSM. For demo we can use wrapped keys in cloud KMS; for enterprise BYOK we'll support KMIP gateway. Need vendor certs and keywrap algos (RSA-OAEP-256, AES-KW-256).

Sam: Proposed milestones: security review by 2024-05-06, POC by 2024-05-20, internal dry-run 2024-05-24, partner demo 2024-05-27. OK?

Priya: Sounds doable. I'll spin up a SCIM test tenant and share creds to the partner doc when ready.

Diego: I'll draft IAM templates: demo SA -> `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter`, BYOK import perms -> `cloudkms.importCryptoKeyVersion`. Also add KMIP egress note (port 5696).

LegalBot: Legal checklist: NDA done, need data-flow diagram, export-control attestation, and co-marketing boilerplate. ETA for review after assets: ~4 business days.

Sam: I'll open infra ticket for KMIP egress and tag eng-infra. Marketing wants logo SVG + 1-line blurb after dry-run.

Priya: Test plan: SCIM provision/unprovision, SAML login smoke, key wrap/unwrap roundtrip. I'll add CI smoke tests.

Diego: We should avoid storing plaintext keys. Store wrapped blobs + metadata only. For demo retention=30d.

deploy-bot: Label applied: partnership/secureedge, marketplace, security-review

Sam: Great. Next sync Fri 9:30am PT. Drop blockers in the partner doc before then.
